Definition: adverb from G3117; from a distance or afar:--afar off, from far.
BiblicalUsage: Makrothen means from afar, afar off, and it is the word for standing at a distance. Luke 18:13 has the publican standing afar off, unwilling to lift his eyes to heaven, and Luke 22:54 has Peter following afar off into the high priest's house, while Mark 15:40 has the women looking on afar off at the cross.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that the distance in all three verses is the same one: close enough to see, too far to stand beside, and honest about it.
